moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lk-halftone, written here): Dot grid (10 px pitch on a 320 frame), dot radius = density x cell / 2; the density field animates on a 1500 ms sine (recipe). Demo: radius 5 x clamp(1 - d / 110), d = distance to a bright spot swinging +-60 px over 3 s. Params: pitch (10 px) · max (5 px) · period (1.5 s).
